# CBini OrquestrAI

> Self-hosted engineering layer for AI: specialized agents propose, people approve, and every executed command is isolated, recorded and,
> where supported, reversible. This repository is public documentation only; the product source code is private and the project is not open source.

Index for AI agents and tools reading this repository. All links point to public documents in this repository.
Languages: English (default) and Brazilian Portuguese (files ending in -BR.md / -br.md).

Key facts:
- AI-proposed commands never run on their own; a person approves each one. Factory-generated content is written by validated generators.
- Approved commands run in a disposable, network-less, unprivileged environment that sees only their own project.
- Maturity labels: Available (proven by automated tests and a human operator on a live deployment), In validation (built and tested, not
  promoted), Configurable, Planned.
- Available: governed execution, revert of file changes, read-only project terminal, cost telemetry, governed lessons, static-site factory,
  encrypted off-site backup, full-stack factory (React + Vite + TypeScript, Express, SQLite; one data model, additive changes).
  Planned: clean-server
  recovery, guided installer, more stacks.
- When cloud AI providers are used, content sent to them follows those providers' policies.
